name: PlayM2M
storyline:
Once upon a time in the far north. Four hundred years ago, Ninla, queen of Anathen, was condemned to a terrible curse. Under the curse, the once beautiful queen was transformed into a disfigured and evil snake-bodied naga creature. Henceforth she would live her life as an evil creature. That is why she was now called Naga. Naga in the sacred religion meant cursed and to be avoided.

From the impact of the curse, the mutant army under Naga's command brought bitter destruction and a terrible curse to the dynasty. This great curse spread from Queen Naga's palace and within a year it had taken over the entire continent within Anathen. Four great dynasties united to fight for the future of their empire, and the Rahun sorceress Rahunatra trapped the curse deep within Anathen with the help of ancient and dark ancient magic! In return for their service, the goddess of Anathen granted the four great dynasties, Rahun, Rasan, Teven and Solon, the will of independence and freedom from each other.

Each dynasty became the sacred and magical army of Anathen, representing the four symbols.
summary:
In PlayM2M, an open-world fantasy online role-playing game, players can choose from four character classes: Dorhan, Skogr, Petrun, and Wizard. Each class has two specializations that offer distinct combat styles for Player vs. Environment (PvE) and Player vs. Player (PvP) modes.

PlayM2M focuses on real-time combat, crafting, exploration, and PvE and PvP content. Currently available in 11 languages, PlayM2M continues to grow with new content and plans for future international expansion.
